page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ine.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs from the Intel Xeon processor family operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. It lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, making it unsuitable for workloads requiring hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning acceleration. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 23 Gbps.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a general-purpose resource. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated Intel Xeon processor allocation provides predictable compute capacity for workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads include standard web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and general-purpose business applications.
